title: Small but extremely efficient!
text: Small but extremely efficient!. Packaged really well! I had brought some burning oils from a local shop and needed a burner. This works so well! My house has never smelled better (and I am addicted to bath and body works candles and warmers!).

product_metadata.title: ComSaf Ceramic Tealight Candle Holder Oil Burner, Essential Oil Incense Aroma Diffuser Furnace Home Decoration Romantic White Set of 2
features: The oil burner size: bowl diameter 3.75 inch/9.5cm; height 4.5inch/11.5cm; bowl capacity: 3oz. Set of 2.
Tealight Holder made of glazed ceramic with hollow-carved design, giving an artful appeal to your indoor space. Ideal for home/ office table/living room/bedroom decoration.

The essential oil burner has beautiful cut-out star and floral patterns. Hollowed-out design allows tealight to go through out. When glowing, it looks like many twinkling stars and swaying flowers in your room.

Simply put a few drops of essential oil into the bowl and light a small candle. Then, you are good to go. Narrower and deeper tray will increase burning time of aroma oil. Candle spoon is offered for free.

**Caution: Candle and essential oil are Not included. And don't touch the surface when candle is lighted.**For the purpose of safety, it is strongly recommended to add some water to this essential oil burner before you are going to heat essential oil, tea leaf, wax or fragrant powder, to avoid ceramic cracking due to uneven heating.
